every .seq line is '#' plus 12 values, a label file exists for each item, no missing values
the last label of an item ends within 3 frames of the end of its EMA signal
x increases from tongue tip to dorsum to back in nearly every item (x grows towards the back of the mouth)

differences: The paper counts 7352 phones and at least 18 short pauses ('minimum ... 18 for short pauses'); the label files hold 7350 labels in all (pauses included) and 17 short pauses (_), so these two counts do not reproduce and are not used as checks. The paper says about 12 minutes of speech; the EMA signals are 22.5 minutes in all, silences included.
